query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_active,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NOT NULL AND street != '' AND street != 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_street,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NULL OR street = '' OR street = 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_street,
  SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as geocoded,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(latitude, ',', longitude)) as unique_coords
FROM pco_people WHERE status = 'active'
